name: Sonnet price momentum
strategy: Rotate into laggard defensive/value sectors (healthcare, financials, duration) while shorting exhausted momentum extremes (gold miners, gold, leveraged semis) — a mean-reversion/relative-value book, not trend-following.
novelty: Both prior rounds chased strongest trailing momentum (AI-infra/semis, mega-cap tech, small caps). Round 3 instead harvests relative-value and mean-reversion: going long sectors that have lagged the broad tape but show early re-acceleration (biotech, healthcare, financials/regional banks, long-duration Treasuries as a rate-cut carry play) while actively shorting the most extended, now-cracking momentum trades (gold/gold miners down double digits in 1m/3m, leveraged semis SOXL post-blowoff). Discipline is enforced via hard stops rather than by riding trend strength.

positions.thesis: Biotech showing sharp 1m re-acceleration (+14.6%) after a long lag vs SPY; relative-value catch-up trade with genuine recent breakout confirmation.
Healthcare sector deeply lagged (12m only +1.1% vs SPY +22.7%) but turning up 1m/3m; defensive rotation candidate as breadth broadens beyond tech.
Financials showing broad strength (+6% 1m) as steepening/rate-cut backdrop favors bank margins; relative-value complement to tech-heavy prior books.
Regional banks confirming financials strength with even stronger 1m (+5.5%) and 3m momentum; carry-like income exposure via bank equities.
Long-duration Treasuries as a rate-cut-cycle carry/diversifier against equity risk; cheap convexity if growth data softens into year-end.
Gold miners in a sharp breakdown (-13.2% 1m, -24.3% 3m) after a huge prior run; shorting the unwind of an exhausted trade, not chasing a new one.
Gold rolling over (-6.1% 1m, -15.5% 3m) as real rates and risk appetite pressure the metal; pairs with GDX short for a broken-momentum theme short.
3x semis ETF just posted a violent -39.2% 1m reversal after a +500% 12m blowoff top; shorting continuation of the momentum unwind with tight risk control.

outlook: Expect continued rotation out of the most extended AI/semis/gold momentum trades into laggard defensives (healthcare) and rate-sensitive value (financials, duration) as the second half unfolds; broad market likely grinds higher but leadership churns, favoring relative-value/mean-reversion over trend-chasing.
